adt_year.description: Year of the published average daily traffic count, when present.
adt_year.title: ADT Year

approach_roadway_width_ft.description: Approach roadway width in feet (SNBI B.G.09), when published.
approach_roadway_width_ft.title: Approach Roadway Width (ft)

average_daily_traffic.description: Average daily traffic on the highway carried by the bridge, when published.
average_daily_traffic.title: Average Daily Traffic

bridge_condition.description: FHWA bridge condition classification (Good / Fair / Poor per 23 CFR 490), calculated by FHWA in the source data (SNBI B.C.12).
bridge_condition.title: Bridge Condition

bridge_name.description: Bridge name as published (SNBI B.ID.02), when present.
bridge_name.title: Bridge Name

bridge_number.description: Bridge Number assigned by the reporting agency (SNBI B.ID.01); stable across annual editions.
bridge_number.title: Bridge Number

county_code.description: County (parish) code within the state as published (SNBI B.L.02).
county_code.title: County Code

culvert_condition_rating.description: Culvert condition rating 0-9 as published, or 'N' when not applicable (SNBI B.C.04).
culvert_condition_rating.title: Culvert Condition Rating

data_year.description: NBI edition year the record was taken from.
data_year.title: Data Year

deck_area_sqft.description: Calculated deck area in square feet (SNBI B.G.16), when published.
deck_area_sqft.title: Deck Area (sq ft)

deck_condition_rating.description: Deck condition rating 0-9 as published, or 'N' when not applicable (SNBI B.C.01).
deck_condition_rating.title: Deck Condition Rating

deck_width_curb_to_curb_ft.description: Bridge width curb-to-curb in feet (SNBI B.G.06), when published.
deck_width_curb_to_curb_ft.title: Deck Width Curb-to-Curb (ft)

deck_width_out_to_out_ft.description: Bridge width out-to-out in feet (SNBI B.G.05), when published.
deck_width_out_to_out_ft.title: Deck Width Out-to-Out (ft)

feature_crossed.description: Name(s) of the feature(s) passing under the bridge (SNBI B.F.03 of 'below' feature records).
feature_crossed.title: Feature Crossed

functional_class_code.description: Functional classification code of the highway carried, as published (SNBI B.H.01).
functional_class_code.title: Functional Class Code

highway_agency_district.description: Highway agency district code as published (SNBI B.L.04).
highway_agency_district.title: Highway Agency District

inventory_rating_factor.description: Inventory load rating factor (SNBI B.LR.05), when published.
inventory_rating_factor.title: Inventory Rating Factor

last_inspection_date.description: Most recent inspection date found in the record's inspection history, YYYY-MM-DD.
last_inspection_date.title: Last Inspection Date

latitude.description: Latitude of the bridge in decimal degrees, when provided by the source (SNBI B.L.05).
latitude.title: Latitude

location.description: Bridge location description as published (SNBI B.L.11).
location.title: Location

longitude.description: Longitude of the bridge in decimal degrees, when provided by the source (SNBI B.L.06).
longitude.title: Longitude

maintenance_code.description: Maintenance responsibility agency code as published (SNBI B.CL.02).
maintenance_code.title: Maintenance Responsibility Code

max_span_length_ft.description: Maximum span length in feet (SNBI B.G.03), when published.
max_span_length_ft.title: Max Span Length (ft)

nbis_bridge_length_ft.description: NBIS bridge length in feet (SNBI B.G.01), when published.
nbis_bridge_length_ft.title: NBIS Bridge Length (ft)

operating_rating_factor.description: Operating load rating factor (SNBI B.LR.06), when published.
operating_rating_factor.title: Operating Rating Factor

owner_code.description: Owner agency code as published (SNBI B.CL.01).
owner_code.title: Owner Code

posting_status_code.description: Most recent load posting status code as published (SNBI B.PS.01).
posting_status_code.title: Posting Status Code

route_carried.description: Name of the feature carried on the bridge, typically the route or road name (SNBI B.F.03 of the carried feature record).
route_carried.title: Route Carried

route_number.description: Route number of the carried highway, as published (SNBI B.RT.02), when present.
route_number.title: Route Number

scraped_at.description: UTC timestamp of when this Actor retrieved the record (ISO 8601).
scraped_at.title: Retrieved At

source_endpoint.description: Official FHWA per-state NBI JSON file the record was retrieved from.
source_endpoint.title: Source Endpoint

state.description: Two-letter state / territory code of the source file (e.g. DE).
state.title: State Code (File)

state_code.description: State code as published in the record (SNBI B.L.01).
state_code.title: State Code

state_name.description: State / territory name for the source file.
state_name.title: State Name

substructure_condition_rating.description: Substructure condition rating 0-9 as published, or 'N' when not applicable (SNBI B.C.03).
substructure_condition_rating.title: Substructure Condition Rating

superstructure_condition_rating.description: Superstructure condition rating 0-9 as published, or 'N' when not applicable (SNBI B.C.02).
superstructure_condition_rating.title: Superstructure Condition Rating

toll_code.description: Toll status code as published (SNBI B.CL.05).
toll_code.title: Toll Code

total_bridge_length_ft.description: Total bridge length in feet (SNBI B.G.02), when published.
total_bridge_length_ft.title: Total Bridge Length (ft)

year_built.description: Year the bridge was built (SNBI B.W.01), when published.
year_built.title: Year Built
